page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with line numbers (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30) printed in the right margin beside some lines. Page number and running head at the top. A fragment of the last paragraph ("XXII. Re-") at the foot, right. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: 5& 29. & 148. Quemadmodum enim si in testudine vnica chorda dissonet, totus concentus turbatur: ita si in catholicâ illâ nominis Dei celebratione homo non tantùm non faciat suum officium, sed etiam vitium infpergat, nō potest non male sonare hæc musica. Demus itaque opera-ram, vt titulos Dei nonnisi in re graui, summâ cum reuerentiâ vsurpemus. Deut. 18. v. 18. Rom. 9. v. 5.

XVIII. Inuocatio Dei externa est, quando clarâ voce Dei opem imploramus. Siue id fiat cantu, siue voce non cantante. Vide passim psalmos, qui 10inscribuntur Cantica & Psalmi, & iubent cantare Deo canticum nouum: vt Psal. 18. 67. 68. 96. 96. 149. item dicta Scripturæ, vbi sancti dicuntur clamasse ad Dominum: vt, Exod. 8. vers. 12. c. 14. vers. 10. Num. 12. v. 13. Iudic. 3. v. 9. 1. Sam. 7. vers. 8. 1. Reg. 17. vers. 20. 21. Psal. 3. 4. 17. 18. 22. 15 28. &c.
XIX. Gratiarum actio externa, Deo debita, est voce suâ celebrare Dei maiestatem & opera. Vide titulum præced. & infrà in Poeticis indicem Canticorum in sacris occurrentium. 10

XX. Religio circa iuramentum est virtus, quâ confirmamus veritatem in re controuersâ, Deo teste inuocato. Vide Deut. 6. vers. 13. c. 10. v. 20. Hebr. 6. ver. 16. 1. Cor. 1. v. 23. Comites siue adiunctâ legitimi iura-15menti debent esse veritas, iudicium, & iustitia. Ier. 4. v. 2. Pugnantia sunt, sophisticæ & calumniiosæ interpretationes iuramentorum, iuramenta impia, & periuria, quibus tota vita plena est.

XXI. Religio circa votum est virtus, quâ Deo 20aliquid promittimus, officij gratiuæ animi testâ-di causâ. Ita nempe, vt exercitium aliquod corporis eli-gamus, vltrò & feriò, ad alendam vel excitandam resi-piscentiam & gratitudinem nostram erga Deum. Gen. 28. §§ vers. 20.

page.notes: Marginal numbers (5, 10, 15, 20) are line-count numerals beside the text; their exact lines are approximate, and the two "10" marks are uncertain as to which lines they stand beside. Right-hand "30" beside the XXI paragraph is not clearly legible, so the "20" placed there is doubtful. "§§" after "Gen. 28." is a doubtful sign. Scripture citations are copied as printed, including "Psal. 18. 67. 68. 96. 96. 149." and "Psal. 3. 4. 17. 18. 22. 15 28." with their printed spacing, which may be a printing error. The first line is a continuation from the previous page.
